description: This file defines the AttachmentViewHolder class responsible for displaying attachment items in a RecyclerView within an Android app. It manages the visual representation of different attachment types (images, videos, audio, generic files), handles click events, and updates UI components accordingly.

classes.name: AttachmentViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass that manages the display and interactions of an attachment item, supporting various media types and UI updates.

methods.name: AttachmentViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view holder with context, binding, listener, and preview mode.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Ext function to load an image thumbnail into an ImageView with specified size options.

methods.name: setIndicator
methods.description: Sets an icon indicator based on attachment type.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Updates the description text view and its visibility.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an Attachment object to the view, updating UI components based on the attachment type.

methods.name: showMoreAttachmentsIndicator
methods.description: Displays an indicator showing additional attachment count.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Applies payloads to update specific parts of the view efficiently.
